decisions.reason: Requiring multiple editable document formats does not change which fonts, icons, or design assets must be included for future editing.
The source changes the required delivery formats, not which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The format complaint does not alter any report identifier or identifier-consistency rule.
The requirement for multiple editable formats does not change the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The source decision concerns delivered file formats and does not change footer coverage, presentation, or identifiers.
The required exposure-band mapping remains unchanged regardless of the editable file formats supplied.
The source changes the handoff format requirement, not the dashboard's fields, prominence, or visual treatment.
The requirement for multiple editable formats does not modify internal-page header content or styling.
The complaint about Word-only delivery does not change the accepted visual style or refinement priorities.
The source contains no change to risk-profile-specific report wording.
The file-format requirement does not alter the distribution warning's presence, wording, or visual treatment.
